    Controller photo & manual · Nevco MPC · 871

    Matched to the real panel

    Compare the display, button groups and keypad with your rink’s console. This is an independent training aid; installed options and firmware can differ.

    MPC hockey configuration 871; wired startup, no auxiliary display, timeout timer 0 only. Penalty timeout starts enabled and can be disabled at startup. Panel TIME ON/OFF is inactive with the simulated handheld connected. Ten penalties per team are a trainer limit. Wireless pairing, bookmarks, auxiliary/segment timers, full options configuration, shot clocks, power-loss recovery and chronometer setup are omitted. GOAL toggles the light indicator, not the score.

    Controller instructions / manual ↗

    Optional remote practice is available in Remote controls below the console. Review the accessory selector for supported hardware, connection rules and mode assumptions.
